WITH driver_standings_with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.raceId,
    r.year,
    r.round,
    c.country,
    ds.driverId,
    ds.wins as current_wins,
    LAG(ds.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.driverId, r.year ORDER BY r.round) as prev_wins
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
),
wins_gained_per_driver AS (
  SELECT 
    raceId,
    country,
    driverId,
    current_wins - COALESCE(prev_wins, 0) as wins_gained
  FROM driver_standings_with_prev
),
per_race_average AS (
  SELECT 
    raceId,
    country,
    AVG(wins_gained) as avg_wins_per_race
  FROM wins_gained_per_driver
  GROUP BY raceId, country
),
per_country_average AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(avg_wins_per_race) as country_avg
  FROM per_race_average
  GROUP BY country
),
overall_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) as benchmark
  FROM per_country_average
),
first_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    pca.country,
    pca.country_avg,
    ob.benchmark
  FROM per_country_average pca
  CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark ob
  WHERE pca.country_avg > ob.benchmark
),
second_mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) as second_mean
  FROM first_filter
)
SELECT 
  ff.country,
  ff.country_avg,
  ff.country_avg - ff.benchmark as above_benchmark,
  ff.country_avg - smc.second_mean as above_second
FROM first_filter ff
CROSS JOIN second_mean_calc smc
WHERE ff.country_avg > smc.second_mean
ORDER BY ff.country DESC
